description: Improve your content moderation workflow on Mac with voice-driven assistance. Learn how to manage high-volume queues, documentation, and communication more effectively.
intro: A smooth content moderation workflow on Mac relies on your ability to process high-volume queues while keeping documentation accurate. You can reduce the friction of repetitive administrative tasks by using voice-driven tools to handle the heavy lifting while you focus on policy decisions.
tldr: Moderators often spend half their time on documentation instead of core review tasks.
Voice commands can help you draft incident reports faster in Slack or Notion.
Lazur helps you navigate complex moderation dashboards using screen-aware voice guidance.
Keep your focus on safety decisions by automating the routine parts of your day.

blocks.text: Managing your content moderation workflow on Mac

Your daily work involves a constant stream of flagged content. Most of your time is spent inside a web-based dashboard like ActiveFence or a custom internal tool. Moving between your browser, Slack for team coordination, and Notion for policy updates is where you lose momentum. You need a way to keep your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the screen.

Documentation is a massive part of the job. You have to log every decision for audit trails. This often means typing the same incident descriptions over and over. Instead of switching windows to copy and paste, use your voice to draft reports. Hold the fn key on your Mac to dictate your notes directly into your moderation tool or your team Slack channel.
Draft your incident logs using voice dictation to keep your hands free for navigation. This helps you maintain your throughput while meeting your reporting requirements.
blocks.title: Speed up reporting

blocks.text: Moderation dashboards are often cluttered with data points and status buttons. If you are new to a platform or need to find a specific setting quickly, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where the button is. Lazur will draw a circle around the element on your screen. This saves you from hunting through nested menus or obscure UI elements during a high-pressure queue.

When you need to update a policy document in Notion, you do not have to stop your review process. Ask Lazur to draft the update based on your spoken notes. You can then quickly paste the text into your document. This keeps your documentation current without breaking your flow of review.

blocks.text: Why voice control matters for moderators

The psychological impact of the work is real. Reducing the physical strain of repetitive clicking and typing can help you stay focused. By using voice commands for routine tasks, you save your energy for the complex decisions that require your human judgment. Always follow your employer's rules regarding sensitive data. Do not dictate private user information or PII into any tool that is not approved by your organization.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with all moderation platforms?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any app on your Mac. Since most moderation dashboards run in Chrome or Safari, Lazur can see and point to elements on your screen regardless of the specific platform you use.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using voice commands?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur listens and looks at your screen only when you hold the shortcut key. No audio or screen data is stored, and your content is never used to train AI models.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is designed to guide you. It will point to the button or explain how to perform an action, but you must complete the click yourself.
